title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.29368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. translated_title: SAE-Audit：通过稀疏自编码器证据审计的推理时黑盒大语言模型优化进行临床试验预测
translated_abstract: 临床试验成本高昂且往往需要数年才能完成，因此早期结局预测对试验规划具有重要价值。大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于预测临床试验结局，但其预测仍然不可靠，且其给出的理由可能无法忠实反映其答案背后所依据的证据。在预测一项注册临床试验将顺利完成还是提前终止等任务上，前沿LLM在我们实验中的表现仅略高于随机水平。我们提出SAE-Audit方法，该方法在推理时利用从可部署的开源模型中获得的证据来优化黑盒LLM。具体而言，将Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的冻结稀疏自编码器（SAE）转换为临床概念词表，并在历史试验数据上拟合稀疏探针，以确定哪些概念与试验结局相关。对于新的试验方案，探针检测到的概念将被写成证据，每条证据都带有方向和强度（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出SAE-Audit方法，将开源模型上稀疏自编码器检测到的临床概念证据用于推理时优化黑盒大语言模型，从而提升临床试验结局预测的准确性和可解释性。
en_tdlr: Proposes SAE-Audit, which optimizes black-box LLMs at inference time using clinical-concept evidence extracted via sparse autoencoders from an open model, improving the accuracy and interpretability of clinical-trial outcome prediction.
